nom: Exuviance Deep Clean AHA Face Cleanser + Makeup Remover

avis.texte: I love this wash. I have dry acne prone. Used to be super oily till I got a good regiment. Bought this for yrs nothing compares. Ive tried so many other washes. Takes off everything, its gentle. No smell, wish it didnt have dyes, but its amazing. My skin is perf

I am 40 years old and have always struggled with my skin. It's quite sensitive, none of the cheap popular products worked (The Ordinary), in fact they would make me break out. This face wash has been a Godsend for me! Cleared my skin, improved my texture! I use this as step 2 of my double cleanse.

I have been struggling with milia for basically forever. I have very sysitive skin too. i could never find a face wash that truely removed the sticky oils, flacky skin and clear my pores. most of the products i tried would strip the top layer of EVERYTHING, making my skin so dry and tight while leaving the deep seeded (open) pores untouched. It was to the point i was afraid to use SPF because i knew it would basically never leave my face. After using this just one time my little open pores on my cheek where so clean they where lines instead of Os.

I usually have normal to.oily skin prone to breakouts and I have enlarged pores from not taking the right care of them for years. this cleanser is so good for clearing, preventing breakouts, non gritty exfoliation does the trick to minimize pores and even skin. it's a must have for me!
I have combination/oily skin. It has a clean cucumber scent however, it really dries my akin and left it feeling less than totally clean and made my akin have a rough texture

I have combination skin, and a nice associate at Ulta recommended this product to me. I have very confused skin, and all products I have used in the past strip my skin and make it flaky. Since I have been using this continuously for four months, my skin texture has improved so much and cleared tremendously.

avis.titre: Did not work and was drying
avis.texte: I was using the Exuviance's face wash for oily skin, which I liked, but switched to this. I have acne-prone dry skin and wanted something less drying. This made my face breakout in small red bumps/pimples and they've only gotten worse. My skin is drier too! It does however feel cleansing to use and gets off any makeup. This could work for other people but it didn't for me!

avis.titre: Best cleanser I have ever used
avis.texte: I love this cleanser! This stuff works like nobodys business! My skin texture and tone has improved tremendously. I will be repurchasing when i run out.

avis.titre: Dermatologist put me on this 20 years ago!
avis.texte: I have always had oily skin. Now as im older its more combination. Ok, first off. This product only has a few hundred reviews because they changed the packaging on EVERYTHING exuviance. Before they did that, it had thousands of reviews. It used to be a light green color. #2 my dermatologist put me on this in 2004.. I instantly loved it… it's the only thing that'll really clean my face without stripping it and therefore making it itchy. My dermatologist loved this so much, She sold it in her office. I have tried to buy other face washes just for something new and different … I always end up hating them and coming back to this anyway.

I bought this face wash a few years ago for an early Black Friday deal. I was highly impressed after the first use. I am over 40 with mature combination skin. The love the scent it's fresh and not overwhelming. I have noticed wrinkles appear to me softer and less noticeable. Major improvement in my skin texture. All in all this is such a wonderful face wash. It gives a good lather, rinses off, and face feel baby smooth after every use. I use at least once daily sometimes twice. I have repurchased several times and it's a huge bonus when it's on sale.
Every day cleanser, takes off all my makeup and makes me feel clean and refreshed. Non drying

This is my holy grail facewash!! I've tried multiple face washes in the past, including professional lines purchased through the Medi spa I'm a client of and this is still my go to face cleanser. My skin is bright and bouncy after use and it also helps with my oily skin. I never write reviews but after seeing this product only having around 350 reviews I felt compelled to do so in order to share the good news with others!!
I have sensitive skin with rosacea and this has been a staple for years. I rarely review but I would highly recommend this product. It does the job and does so while calming the skin.

I think this is the most underrated product at Ulta. If you have oily skin and live in a hot and sticky climate, this will leave you feeling clean. Very similar to a Dr's office brand that costs $50 per bottle.

After using this product once, I woke up with little white bumps and dry flakes around my nose and chin area. I did not use any other new products, so I am certain that it was this product that did not work out for me.
This helped clear up my dark spots and acne troubles. Made my face brighter in the best way possible. Skin bounces back for once!
I absolutely love this face wash. I have been using for years. It cleans without drying and leaves face refreshed.
This product took off everything without drying, stubborn eye liner, sunscreen all of it, I will definitely be repurchasing.
My esthetician recommended this cleanser and it is honestly the best one I've used in years!

I have used this cleanser for years. Every time I try something else, I'm running back to Exuviance. It's gentle & prevents breakouts & keeps my skin moisturized at the same time. I have very sensitive, dry skin.

I bought this on a whim recently as one of the black friday deals. Then waited a while to use it because I hadn't thought much of it. Once I finally used it I had instant regret that I didn't buy more bottles! It feels amazing on, is a gel consistency and a tiny amount goes a small way. It also got all of my make up off! I'm obsessed!!

This is the best cleanser that I've ever tried. I buy other cleansers periodically to see how they compare and none of them come close to how well this Exuviance cleanser works. It removes all of my stubborn makeup without any hassle. It actually makes my skin feel CLEAN after washing unlike many other products out there. I really do feel like it's helped keep any acne or breakouts at bay and has evened out my skin tone. I really have nothing bad to say about this product besides wishing there was a travel-size option for this because it's that good - I bring the whole bottle with me because I can't go without it.
Excited to try this but didn't like the smell, cant stand it, returning
Cleans and removes makeup without leaving skin tight and dry feeling!

This was recommended to me by the sales lady who had gorgeous skin. My only regret with this purchase is not having bought it sooner. It takes hardly any product and lathers very well. It is a gel consistency. My face feels so smooth and clean afterwards. It also smells good which is a plus too. I've used almost two weeks and can already see and feel the difference.

I didn't use the product, gifted it to a family member. ingredients and claims sound very promising, I will update on here once I hear her feedback. it's hard to tell the true effects with skincare so soon
this has surely become my favorite daily cleanser. it's gentle yet gives me a super deep clean. it's a gel formula that lathers up nicely. I highly recommend
Love this product alot. It really deep clea s and removes all makeup residue on the face. Amazing 👏

I'm surprised by how many reviews say this product is good at removing makeup. It absolutely does not remove my foundation, even in the shower. I use toner on a cotton pad after I wash my face. When I use Exuviance, there is foundation all over the cotton pad - A LOT of foundation. I haven't seen any benefit or change to my skin in the 2 months I've been using Exuviance. It's a hard no for me.

I enjoyed trying this cleanser out. It was a nice change but I didn't feel like it removed all my makeup in one wash. I found myself washing my face a second time just to make sure all my makeup, dirt, and oil was removed. The cleanser is extremely gentle and didn't strip my face. If you don't mind doing a second cleanse then this is a good option to try. The product size and price point is really reasonable.
This is my night cleanser and it does such an amazing job of removing all the oil, sweat, suncreen, and whatever else from my skin. Absolutely a 10/10, would highly recommend.
Shocked to see so many glowing reviews. Left the skin around my eyes raw and burning

avis.titre: After using almost every night since Dec 2021…
avis.texte: I had low/no expectations and was afraid this might be too drying since it's AHA, but it feels very gentle yet leaves my skin squeaky clean. I wear light foundation and liquid eyeliner, shadow, UD primer potion, the works. And this removes all of it without leaving me dry. I have combo skin with some shine and hyperpigmentation and this left me balanced. Perfect before bedtime and prepares your skin for your nighttime routine. I dont typically use it in the AM. I got it over 18 months ago during 21 days of beauty and I still have plenty left. A little goes a long way to create a nice creamy lather. Has similar makeup removing qualities to me as Kiehls Calendula cleanser. Would buy again!
I was refered this product by an Ulta employee because I was having post wax break out and when I tell you! This stuff CLEARED my break out in TWO days!!!! No cap all facts! And it feels like silk
I just started using this product and really like the smell and the lathering effect. A little goes a long way. My skin comes out squeaky clean after using it.

I bought this along with a toner and it wraps it up for me and this brand. All of the moisturizers and serums pill, do nothung, but this cleanser was one of the worst. It smells terrible, and while I do appreciate the gel texture, it dried my eyelids and irritated for days.

avis.titre: Why is no one talking about the smell
avis.texte: This cleanser works great. I cannot get past the smell. It smells like toilet cleaner to me.

avis.titre: An Ulta employee recommended it to me and I am sold
avis.texte: I was browsing thru Ulta at Watchung, NJ and one of their always nice employees came up to me while I was in the skincare aisle. She recommended this to me after our conversation. yes its a little pricey BUT a little goes a very long way PLUS it leaves your face clean and not dried out. I think it does an amazing job for my skin. I'll definitely rebuy it once this is empty. Only had it 3 days and its been amazing

I've tried so many face washes and I always come back to this one. This one feels like it really cleans my skin without leaving a dry felling or like there a film left behind like other face washes. The whole exuviance line is amazing

Honestly, it's the first time using this cleanser and I really liked it! It leaves the skin very soft with a healthy glow, that feeling of clean and cared for skin. Exuviance really has very good skincare products and I will keep trying them!

avis.titre: Amazing cleanser and a little goes a long way!
avis.texte: I love this stuff. Its doesn't strip your akin. It doesnt feel tight. Perfect for daya nd night.
I get a real clean feeling. I have always used Noxzema ever since I was a child. All though I like Noxzema, I now have a grownup cleanser. Thank You Lana!!!
Love love love this facewash! Feels amazing going on and coming off.

This product is designed for very oily skin or skin with a lot of breakouts. If you're sensitive or dry; this isn't for you. My skin dried up so much more than usual and I had to put a lot of Tatcha Dewy Face Cream to be able to balance it out. I will say it got rid of my super deep blackheads on my nose in less than 3 days of using it
I have been using this product for years. It cleans well without drying my skin

I was originally using Fresh soy cleaners and j wanted to try something new. An Ulta employee recommended me this plus the toner… I regret buying it. My face feels EXTREMELY dry after use. It was so bad it dried my skin out. My skin started flakey and it was burning. I thought maybe bc it was new my skin was purging but nope. Dried out my forehead and temple now there's a red ring around my face and it dried out my eyes and under eyes and my chin. Definitely not for sensitive skin! I wish I can post my face so y'all can see how red it is!

This cleaner is great!! it smooths my skin very nicely and makes products sink in nicely. it doesn't leave my skin quenched and it even removes water proof mascara. BUT it is a little pricy. I use this product 3-4 times a week and it takes me almost 6 months to go their the bottle. its def worth the money, just costs a little more up front

I love Exuviance but they are speedy and their bottles are unbelievably small, this bottle is huge though! Very pleased with the size as well as the efficacy of the cleanser. It really helped eliminate tenacious blackheads around my nose, and you really don't need much product to wash your whole face. I'm pleased with how quickly it helped get rid of my blackhead. I found it to be slightly drying even on my oily skin, so I only use it once a day.
Cleanses without stripping! Skin is never dry after you rinse!
I've been using this product for over 25 years. Nothing better!

By far the best cleanser I've ever used! A little goes a long way and using in conjunction with the Radiance serum has improved the overall appearance of my skin! I now feel more comfortable with not wearing makeup!
I use this entire line of products and let me tell you they are worth the money. My makeup goes on with perfection now. My skin is glowing and glasslike. Buy it!!
If you're ready to level up your cleanser, get this! It made my skin feel smooth and clean and did not irritate. My new fav cleanser!

I have tried literally EVERYTHING to get rid of my hormonal/pcos acne, I've struggled with it for about NINE YEARS! This is probably the only skincare product I have used that has given me practically instant results, without the purging. I was recommended this cleanser by an ulta employee and I'm truly so happy they pointed me to this product. I tend to get lots of neck and cheek pimples accompanied by PIE and other texture from scarring. This cleanser has SIGNIFICANTLY lessened my breakouts, acne scars and any other skin tone unevenness. (WITHIN EVEN THE FIRST COUPLE DAYS OF USE). Do not be scared by the price, this cleanser should last you a while, plus this stuff works so it's not a waste. Please don't wait any longer! Save your skin and get this stuff! 1000000000/10. I'll be going back to ulta to purchase more from this line FOR SURE!

When I started using this product I was dealing with adult acne at the age of 27. A wonderful employee at Ulta heard my concern and recommended this face wash. At first the price was a bit to much for me, but I was willing to try. I started off using it one or twice a week because it was very drying for my face.. however I notice results right away!! I'm not lying when I tell you this help clear up my acne, my face is glowing, very smooth, and I can go without wearing any foundation. I was extremely happy, I went back to thank the employee at Ulta. I've been using this product everyday twice a day. This also helps clear up my stubborn hormonal acne that I get when it's Mother Nature visits. Definitely wear sunscreen when using this product tho!
Not drying and the tube lasts like 5 months! My skin has never felt this smooth and clean before.

I absolutely recommend this Cleanser! It is highly effective and leaves my skin feeling and looking so radiant and smooth after a few uses! I love the cleanser on the road as well and kept my face smooth and no acne !

I really enjoy using this cleanser. It does not irritate my skin at all. it has a nice lather and keeps my skin feeling squeaky clean but also clear. my pores appear smaller and my complexion has a nice glow and appears brighter after using this consistently.
New skin revealed! Been using for over a year now, my skin is glowing and bright. This is something great for a lady at 70 years old !

Have been using this cleanser for years now after being recommended to resolve a bout of hormonal acne and it has been excellent. I have sensitive skin and this has not caused any issues when used with the balance toner. Occasionally I experienced some dryness in my skin but typically when using other serums products. Overall it's been very good.
Absolutely the best! Removes all makeup including mascara leaving my face feel clean and fresh.

I was gifted this Exuviance Deep Clean AHA Cleanser in exchange for my honest review. This cleanser gently and deeply cleanses my dry/combination skin without causing excessive dryness. My husband has normal to oily skin and has started using this regularly in place of his usual cleanser. We both love the gentle exfoliating and brightening effects. It cleanses our skin well and leaves our skin looking and feeling smoother and brighter.

I'm in my late 40s and received this as a sample and tried it when I ran out of my other facial cleanser. After finishing that, went ahead and bought the big bottle after seeing and feeling, the results. (A little goes a long way!) Face feels soft, firm, glowing and smooth. It's my new fav cleanser!

I love how nice this product feels going on the skin, however I don't feel after all these weeks that there has been any real change or improvement in my skin. I do like how my skin doesn't feel completely stripped of my natural oils while using this.

Great cleanser! It doesn't strip my skin and it leaves it so smooth and clean. It has a slight scent but I genuinely like it, it's subtle enough that it's not overwhelming. I use it at night but would definitely make this a staple in my routine.

Never heard of this brand before this. Thank you Influenster for introducing me to this brand. The package is absolutely beautiful and the product is amazing. It's a gel and you only need a tad bit. It foams up nicely. After using this my face cleared up and feels squeaky clean after every wash. Highly recommend and will continue to purchase.

Love this cleanser! I have oily combination skin so finding a cleanser that able to deep clean the surface oils is hard but this product does the perfect job without leaving my face super dry. A little amount of product goes a long way. Cleanser does have a slight refreshing scent to which I enjoyed and love the AHA/PHA ingredients benefits. I see myself purchasing this product in the future.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way!
avis.texte: This cleanser lather is it really well. You only need a little bit and it deep cleans your face. It doesn't over dry my skin but I can tell it really cleans out all the dirt from the day. It smells nice and clean but not overpowering at all. I feel like it's gentle on my skin and doesn't ever leave it feeling tight or over dry￼.

I was really surprised by how much I liked this cleanser. It smelled like a spa. My skin felt so smooth after. It didn't dry out my skin. I was very pleased with this moisturizer. This will be my go to travel moisturizer!

The cleanser is so gentle. I love the smell as well. It leaves the skin soft and definitely cleansed. It's not drying either. The packaging is very beautiful. Makes the product seem luxe and expensive.

Okay, so I really enjoyed this cleanser! It smells so amazing and it leaves your skin feeling so soft and clean! I give it a four star because it doesn't fully remove my mascara but it's okay, I just use a make up wipe after. I definitely recommend!

I really enjoy this cleanser. I feels luxurious when I use it. The consistency of it was a shock when I first used it as I was expecting something creamier but I do like it. It feels like it's working and my face feels clean after. It has a nice scent as well. The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is that I feel like my other cleanser does the same and I'm not sure if this is worth the extra money and I like the triple microdermabrasion face polish better than the cleanser so if you're going between the two, I recommend the polish over this.
I have tried many products to help my face and this one is amazing. Easy to use and doesn't smell bad or burn my face.
This cleanser actually helps with my skin from being overly dry. I'm glad I was able to try this product. Definitely will recommend it to others.￼

I have pretty dry skin and this cleanser has really helped with that, a small amount goes a long way so I'm not sure if I'll ever finish the whole bottle. Skin feels really clean even if I don't do an oil cleanser as my precleanse but doesn't have that overly queaky clean feelings

One good thing about this cleanser is a little goes a long way! You only need a small amount because it lathers up really well. The smell wasn't too overpowering. It seemed to clean my makeup off in the shower when I used it. All in all, it does the job, but didn't seem like anything super special to me. I'd be curious to see if I used it longer if I see any big differences in my skin, but I don't so far.

I wanted to like this cleanser because the texture is awesome but it reminds me of public restroom hand soap smell. Additionally it made my skin a little more dry than normal but also made some spots feel like I was getting a pimple.
I am so excited that I got this product. I hadn't heard of the brand before, but it is going to be my go-to! A little bit goes a long way, so it's also great for the price.
this cleanser is gentle but effective. it never burns or tingles, doesn't leave me feeling stripped (but is best for normal to oily skin in my opinion!). i wish there was a fragrance free version!
This cleanser does what it's supposed do. It cleans my face and doesn't leave any residue behind.

I like how it feels on my face - it isn't too harsh but feels like it's cleaning, however I'm not sure it's that different than most of the other cleansers out there. When this runs out I'm not sure if I'll buy it again. It does last awhile so I think you get your money's worth.
I love the feel and smell of this cleanser. I will definitely be buying this again. My skin feels so good after using it
AHAs are tricky. For my skin type this was too drying. If you have a more dry or sensitive skin type and want to try start with once a week to see how your skin tolerates.

This cleanser lathers pretty well for being a gel type texture. It cleansed pretty well and gently though I didn't love the scent. I didn't really notice my skin being any different so I could take it or leave it. It doesn't really take off makeup very well so I still need to do that before cleansing.

I've been using this as a daily cleanser in my double cleanse routine (face oil followed by cleanser) and so far I have really enjoyed it. It has a pleasant scent, foams to a good extent, and leaves my skin feeling clean but not stripped! I would definitely recommend!

Have been using this cleanser once a week since I know it is strong and don't want my skin to dry out. Have not gotten any breakouts at all and skin has been looking glowy! It is a very lightweight cleaner and soft on the skin have really been enjoying it so far have no complaints about it. Love the packaging as well! Definitely recommend this cleanser, do remember to use sun scream since it is a AHA cleanser but should be using sunscreen everyday either way!

just giving my honest opinion. This was just not meant for me but again EVERYONES skin is different and may react different. dont let my opinion change your mind about giving this product a try. Many things I have tried my skin reacts different sometimes can tolerate things sometimes may not. unfortunatley this was nkt meant for my skin. at least for my face. so please if you are wanting to give it a try go for it. it may be meant for your skin !
This product did leave my face feeling super clean but it definitely needs to be matched with a moisturizer. Will definitely become a staple in my deep cleaning facial routine.
Feels like a luxury product. Foams up nicely and is a gentle, mild cleanser great for daily use.

I think it is an excellent product, very pleasant smell and the feeling of cleanliness and softness on the skin is incredible! I have sensitive and combination skin and this product works quite well! I would definitely recommend it

Started using this for a few weeks and love how my skin has been feeling and looking. it's not too harsh on my skin and the scent is nice. probably would repurchase this cleanser once I'm done with this one
I really wanted to love this but I don't think it changed my face much. I'm still having dry skin and breakouts. Perfect "light" cleanser but I feel like I need something a bit stronger.
Amazing for oily skin. If you want cleaner skin and smaller pores get this right now.

I received this cleanser from Influenster to review. The amount of product you get for the price is a great value! It leaves your face feeling clean without stripping it of moisture. I can definitely see myself adding this to my skincare routine!
Very light scent, gentle, cleaned my skin well. I used twice a day and didn't get redness. I would recommend this product.

packaging is cute a little simple but very easy to use. notnto harsh on the smell (sanitizer a little bit ) but I have tried this products for over 3 weeks and I did see and improvement. I didn't like the gel consistency of it at first feels like soap but it does clean off your face very well. does not leave your face dry. In the last 2 weeks I have not broken out as much specially in the chin area

I liked the cleanser it was good and it foamed up nicely. However I did get some irritation and im not sure if the cleanser caused it but every time I used it my skin seemed very tight. It did clean very good.
I absolutely loved this cleanser! It left my skin feeling smooth and fresh and was gentle enough for my sensitive skin. I would definitely recommend!

I absolutely love this product from the feel to the very subtle scent. I like that it only takes a little product to cleanse the whole face. It gently removes all my makeup and helps my skin feel clean without over-drying. It's now a staple in my skincare routine.

The product was a little bit more drying to my skin than what I normally use on a daily process. I did stop using it and might try again in the summer when it is not as dry. I did like the consistency of the lather.

I've been using this cleanser for a few weeks now. I have sensitive skin & many cleansers are too strong or irritate my face. I haven't had any issues with this cleanser. It cleans well, but it's not too strong, nor have I had any reaction to it.
Such a great cleanser! I am really enjoying it and feel like it cleanses my face really well! No complaints! It is definitely worth the price!

I'm shocked by how great my skin feels now that I've been using this cleanser! I knew about Exuviance, but never tried anything from them before until now. My skin feels clean (but not stripped) immediately after washing, and I can tell it's much smoother from the chemical exfoliation. The scent is light and doesn't linger.
It has a great, thick consistency, making a little bit to a long way. I've been using the cleanser for a while now and am still enjoying the way it makes my skin feel.
I love the Exuviance deep clean aha cleanser, I've noticed my pores & black heads have gotten smaller since using this product! I love using it every night before bed.

This product is fantastic - I really cannot say enough good things. First, it's very mildly scented. A tiny bit goes a lot way, it's very silky and if you have any traces of leftover makeup, it will take it right off. Highly recommend - and it helps to clear up skin!
I really enjoy this cleanser. it keeps my skin feeling fresh and doesn't dry out my combination skin. It's gentle and the scent is very mild.
This is a solid cleanser. Lightly scented. This is my first tone using this brand and I enjoyed my time thus far! Easily incorporated into my daily regimen.

I actually really liked this. I have pretty sensitive skin so I wasn't sure but it leaves my skin feeling very soft. It also doesn't seem to dry it out too much. I have combo skin. It seems like the product is going to last me a while so good value!!
I would definitely recommend this product ! It's really effective, my skin was a mess before I discovered this! Now looks gorgeous!
I love how well this cleanser clarifies the skin. It smells amazing and works great! The bottle is huge, and a great value. I would recommend this for oily skin.

I never heard about this product before, so I was a little scared to try it, however it surprised me, because it is very good, and you just need a tiny amount to clean your entire face, plus it's pretty big so it will last forever. Definitely 10/10 for this one!!

avis.titre: Makes my skin feel so clean!
avis.texte: Deep cleansing but doesn't dry your skin out like other deep cleansers. I have dry skin & have had no issue at all. I will be purchasing this when I run out.

I was skeptical about the product because I have severe cystic acne and working with a medical spa for my acne treatment. The nurse I worked with reviewed the active ingredients and gave a thumbs up to the cleanser. I enjoy the cleanser. It has a soft subtle fragrance that isn't overpowering. It gently foams as I run onto my face. My face feels refreshed, and I have peace of mind knowing the active ingredients help fight acne. I quickly wash my face in the morning with the cleanser and pat dry. I haven't broken out worse after starting the product.

I really liked this cleanser! I definitely don't hunk I would replace my current cleanser, but it will definitely go in the rotation. I liked the foaming and the scent. I received this product for free for my review.

I am absolutely obsessed with this cleanser! It cleared my skin up so nicely in what felt like no time. It feels very clean and lightweight. It exceeded my expectations. I would absolutely purchase this.

This cleanser has been a big part of clearing my hormonal acne. It's cleanses the skin, but doesn't strip it. It lathers well, the packaging is clean and sleek looking. I would definitely purchase again.
The Deep AHA cleanser is very lightweight and I only had to use about a dime sized amount to cover my face. It is not a foaming cleanser it's almost like using a cream.

First off, I love the way this product smells,every time I apply it to my face, It reminds me of a vacation, somewhere on a beach lol. Very refreshing overall. I love that it lathers up and I have combination skin, also sensitive as well and it's safe to say this didn't not break me out. I wear make up daily and after I use my make up wipe to remove the make up this thoroughly takes any remaining residue off. I love how refreshed I feel after washing my face with this. My skin doesn't feel oily, or dry after this, it feels as if I just came out of a facial. Definitely recommend this product! #renewwithexuviance I received this product from Influenster
